title: thelypteris draco
intro: Thelypteris draco, commonly known as the dragon fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris draco include its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Thelypteris draco include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
